title: Correction to: Early-life exposure to PM2.5 and risk of acute asthma clinical encounters among children in Massachusetts: a case-crossover analysis.
ehr_evidence: The study used Massachusetts Department of Public Health birth records and Massachusetts Executive Office of Public Safety and Security (EOPSS) hospital discharge data.
summary: This case-crossover analysis examined the association between early-life exposure to PM2.5 and the risk of acute asthma clinical encounters among children in Massachusetts using birth records and hospital discharge data.
data_availability_statement: The Creative Commons Public Domain Dedication waiver (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) applies to the data made available in this article, unless otherwise stated.
